profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer at Epic
profile.summary: I am always motivated to solve problems in the most effective way possible for the best outcome.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop software to interface with infusion pumps and other medical devices

positions.title: Technical Intern of Wireless Technology
positions.description:
- Worked on an Android app used to connect to wireless displays with Miracast technology
- Researched and developed a program used to keep track of a user's identity
- Developed a new user interface for Microsoft Lync for conference rooms
- Developed an interface to connect an Outlook appointment with a Lync meeting

positions.title: Programming 1 Teacher's Assistant
positions.description: I helped beginner programmers with labs in Programming 1 as they learned C++

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Diagnosed and repaired computer problems and other electronics across the Montgomery Independent School District. This involved replacing hundreds of computers across multiple school buildings over the course of a few weeks along with basic hardware and software problems.

positions.title: Videographer
positions.description: I worked as a videographer for my High School. I filmed sports such as Basketball, Volleyball, baseball, and softball.

honors.title: Spring Sing Best Video
honors.description: I directed, wrote, and animated a short video for my club, Psi Epsilon that was voted the best video out of all of the clubs at OC. The video involved a lot of CGI that I rendered within Autodesk 3Ds MAX and used star wars spaceships to create a space battle.
honors.issuer: Issued by Oklahoma Christian University · Mar 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: We went to Honduras to work with the Christians down there. We helped construct a warehouse and a church.

projects.title: Infusion Pump Integration
projects.description: Working to better improve Epic's integration with infusion pumps through IHE/HL7 interfaces

projects.title: Research on how changes to a GUI affect a user's confidence in the system
projects.description: I spent a few months researching whether users responded better to incremental changes in a familiar user interface as compared to one large change to the same user interface

organizations.name: Psi Epsilon service club
organizations.description: I am the Historian of Psi Epsilon. I take pictures and video of events that we participate in and edit them all into videos for the club.
